pr.body: Implemented URL-safe base64 cursors anchored to returned item IDs, strict limit validation for 1–100, and HTTP 400 {"error":"..."} responses for invalid limits or cursors. Updated README and added tests for defaults, bounds, cursors, pagination, ordering, terminal pages, and invalid inputs. Assumption: cursor tokens encode the last returned item ID; clients treat them as opaque. `python3 -m unittest` passed (6 tests); `git diff --check` passed.
pr.summary: Added cursor pagination for GET /items. Before, the endpoint returned all 57 items; now it returns ordered pages of up to 20 by default, with opaque continuation cursors and a null cursor on the last page.
